recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. The published decision is already represented in the authoritative active datatype source, and further prose would be redundant with existing Attachment.url comments rather than a necessary correction.
issue_request: FHIR-16973 was a Published FHIR-core change request resolved Persuasive with Modification. It asked to remove the implication that Attachment.url is only an alternative to Attachment.data by changing the definition from 'An alternative location where the data can be accessed' to 'A location where the data can be accessed' and checking whether more data/location wording was needed.
initial_application: The Jira comment records svn revision #14301. Git commit 17920b99794ce85c84f69b0fb5e338e71f9f01c6, 'GF#16973 - fix language,' is that application and changes source/datatypes/attachment.xml from 'An alternative location where the data can be accessed' to 'A location where the data can be accessed.'
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Attachment under active datatypes and marks Attachment normative, so source/datatypes/attachment.xml is in current build scope. The current Attachment.url comments also state that if both data and url are provided, the url SHALL point to the same content, discuss relative/transient and Bundle-local URIs, require resolution to actual data, and include later security validation guidance. Confluence FHIR Infrastructure minutes for 2018-07-09 list tracker 16973 as Persuasive with Mod in the approved block vote.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current Attachment.url row already says 'A location where the data can be accessed,' and a current-source search found no remaining stale 'alternative location where the data can be accessed' wording.

related_jiras.note: A later reconciliation changed security-warning text in the same Attachment.data and Attachment.url rows; it does not alter the FHIR-16973 wording decision.
